subject: Attestation roadmap, retention change & seat growth (renewal coordination)
messages:
From: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@clearlane.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearlane.com
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal questions — SOC 2 window & seats

Jordan — thanks for the call earlier. Two items procurement needs clarified before we can move to PO: 

1) Our security team has asked whether Redwood can extend the default auth/log retention from 12 months to 18 months for our account. This is specific to access logs and audit trails (SOC 2 scope). We understand this may be an amendment. What’s the impact on price/SLA?

2) We expect production usage to increase by ~25% over the next 6 months. If we take the 12‑month renewal at the proposed pricing, can we lock in a path for an incremental seat/throughput uplift without full re‑procurement?

Can you loop in the renewal/legal folks and outline next steps, timing, and any redlines we should expect on your side?

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ruiz
Security Program Manager, ClearLane Financial

--
Attachments: none
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@clearlane.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal questions — SOC 2 window & seats

Sofia — appreciate the clear list. High level answers below; details and a proposed redline follow from legal tomorrow.  

• Retention: We can offer an 18‑month log retention carve‑out for ClearLane (access logs + audit trail). This is a contract amendment rather than standard practice; it will require a small incremental storage/ingress charge. I’ll include estimated unit cost in the next note.

• Seat/throughput uplift: We can include a growth corridor in the renewal (12 months) that allows two uplift tranches (at +15% and +35%) at pre‑negotiated unit pricing, triggered by an uplift notice and a short PO addendum — avoids full reprocurement.

I’m copying Kimberly (renewals) and Ben (solutions) to start the paperwork and quantify cost. Expect a draft MAP + cost delta by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Account Exec — Redwood Inference

--
From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@clearlane.com>, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft MAP + retention delta (ClearLane renewal)

Team / Sofia — attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short note on retention costs. Key bullets: 

• Retention amendment: 12 → 18 months for access logs and auth audit trail only. Estimated ongoing cost: +$1,200/month (storage + retrieval SLA) for ClearLane’s projected volume. One‑time operational setup: $3,500.

• Growth corridor: Two uplift options at pre‑agreed unit pricing (15% and 35%). Each uplift requires a 14‑day notice and a signed PO addendum. No price increase beyond the uplift price for the 12‑month renewal term.

• Timing: If we sign within 10 business days, we can onboard the retention change to meet the SOC 2 snapshot window in Q3 (audit in late Sep). Otherwise we’d push to the next attestation cycle.

Action items listed in MAP attachment (timeline with owners).

Marissa — legal has a couple of standard carveouts we should consider for retention (encryption key management and deletion windows). Can you take point on the redline?

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Renewals — Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: soc2-evidence-index.xlsx, MAP-V1.2.docx, retention-change-patch-2026-06.pdf
From: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@clearlane.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearlane.com
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 11:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + retention delta (ClearLane renewal)

Thanks Kimberly — quick clarifications from our side:  

1) The $1,200/month looks reasonable; procurement needs a line itemized estimate to include in the PO. Can you provide month 1 estimate and an annualized number?

2) On the retention carveout: our security lead asked that retained logs be stored encrypted at rest with customer‑managed keys (KMS) for the 18‑month window. Is that supported or would that require a separate KMS integration addendum?

3) For the growth corridor, procurement will want the exact uplift activation process documented (who signs, typical lead time). If you can add a short SOP to the MAP we’ll be able to accept the mechanism in the PO.

We also looped in Elena from Audits‑R‑Us (our SOC 2 vendor) — she may request evidence extracts; please expect a manual evidence pull once you agree the retention timing.

Appreciate it — Sofia

--
From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@clearlane.com>, Elena Gomez <elena@audits-r-us.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + retention delta (ClearLane renewal)

Quick notes from legal & compliance: 

• KMS: We support customer‑managed keys (Cloud KMS/HSM) as an addendum. It’s not in standard hosted plans; adding CMK requires a short security integration SOP and an annual $4k key management fee. I attached the retention patch that lists the exact controls we’ll apply for the 18‑month window.

• Evidence pulls: For Elena — we can provide scoped, time‑boxed evidence extracts (readonly) and a one‑time export in CSV/PARQUET for the audit period. If you need frequent pulls we should budget for recurring extracts and engineering hours.

• SOP for uplift activation: Ben, please draft a 2‑page SOP that spells out the PO addendum flow, signatory list, and expected provisioning lead times (14 business days for capacity increases).

Lauren — please prepare the initial redline for the retention amendment; we’ll aim to keep the changes minimal (encryption, KMS clause, data deletion schedule).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success & Compliance — Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: retention-change-patch-2026-06.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@clearlane.com>, jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 17:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Next steps: PO language, DocuSign & tech prep

Sofia — thanks for the patience. Final checklist to close the renewal this week: 

1) PO line item estimates (monthly + annual) — attached below.
   • Retention (18 months): $1,200/month; annualized line = $14,400/year. First month includes $3,500 one‑time setup (pro‑rated if signed mid‑month).

2) DocuSign: We’re ready to send an amendment for the retention + growth corridor. Link: https://www.docusign.net/SEALINK/abcdef123456 (will route to procurement@clearlane.com).

3) KMS integration: Marissa flagged $4k/year fee for customer managed keys; if ClearLane wants CMK we’ll include the addendum in the DocuSign. Please confirm.

4) Evidence readiness: Elena — we’ve queued a scoped export for the proposed Q3 snapshot. Can you confirm the exact time range auditors will need and whether CSV or parquet is preferred? We’ll schedule the engineering run once the amendment is signed.

5) SOP: Ben will publish the 2‑page uplift SOP to the shared Drive folder and reference it in the MAP. Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cClearlane-soc2-evidence

If we get a signed amendment by EOD Thu we can hit the target window for the auditor snapshot in Sep.

Thanks — I’ll wait on procurement confirmation and note acceptance of KMS option.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference

--
